name: Bar Glow
author: 07dcolem
description: Full-width glow behind the stock Omarchy bar, with a settings panel for opacity, bloom, glow color, and forced glyph color. Does not replace omarchy.bar.

barWidget.description: Glow wash behind the bar, plus a panel to tune opacity, bloom, colors, and glyph contrast

schema.label: Show glow
schema.description: Draw the glow wash behind the bar.

schema.label: Bloom (px)
schema.description: Soft falloff past the inner edge of the bar. 0 is a hard wash with no bloom.

schema.label: Opacity (%)
schema.description: Peak opacity of the glow. Values above 1 in shell.json are treated as percent.

schema.label: Glow color
schema.description: Hex color for the wash, or theme to follow Color.background.

schema.label: Follow theme colors
schema.description: Glow uses the theme background and glyphs use the theme foreground. Live-updates on omarchy theme set.

schema.label: Force glyph color
schema.description: Override the wallpaper-sampled bar text color.

schema.label: Glyph color
schema.description: Forced bar icon/label color. Ignored when Force glyph color is off.
